in_sanskrit.name: Arishay
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है King of Gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Arishay एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Arishay is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Arishta', which means 'King of Gods'. This name is associated with the revered Hindu deity Indra, who is the god of rain, thunderbolts, and fertility.
